title: 1990-91 Skybox #10 Anthony "Spud" Webb Atlanta Hawks Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a vintage 1990-91 Skybox basketball trading card featuring Anthony "Spud" Webb of the Atlanta Hawks. The card is a part of the base set and has the card number 10. It is in standard size and was manufactured in the United States by SkyBox. The card is in English language and is unsigned by the player. 

The card is a great addition to any collection for fans of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and basketball in general. It is a must-have for fans of the Atlanta Hawks and collectors of vintage trading cards. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this rare card to your collection!
